title: The Mystery of Imaginary Numbers
description: Discover how numbers that don't exist in the real world became the secret engine powering modern technology.
character_reference: a curious young woman with bright purple hair tied in a messy bun, wearing a dark blue zip-up hoodie

scenes.narration: What happens when you multiply a number by itself? You always get a positive result, right? Positive times positive is positive, and negative times negative is also positive.
scenes.visual: glowing digital numbers floating in mid-air inside a dark laboratory, neon blue light reflecting off polished steel surfaces

scenes.narration: So what number multiplied by itself could possibly give you negative one? For the longest time, the answer was a flat nothing.
scenes.visual: close-up of a digital calculator screen displaying an error message under dim fluorescent lighting

scenes.narration: Mathematicians decided to invent a fictional number called i, representing the square root of negative one, just to solve stubborn cubic equations.
scenes.visual: hand sketching a glowing lowercase letter i on a transparent glass board with a neon stylus

scenes.narration: They called them imaginary numbers, assuming they were just a useless mathematical toy with zero connection to reality.
scenes.visual: dust motes drifting slowly through a beam of warm sunlight in a quiet, cluttered attic room

scenes.narration: Yet, centuries later, these fake numbers turned out to be the exact key needed to unlock quantum mechanics and alternating electrical currents.
scenes.visual: intricate wave patterns glowing in pulsing cyan and magenta light across a dark curved display screen

scenes.narration: Without imaginary numbers, Wi-Fi, radio waves, and modern electronics simply wouldn't function the way they do.
scenes.visual: close-up of intricate microchip circuits glowing with pulsing electrical currents in amber and blue hues

scenes.narration: Sometimes the most unreal concepts end up describing our reality better than anything else.
scenes.visual: abstract kaleidoscope of geometric fractals shifting smoothly into sharp focus

scenes.narration: Follow along for more bite-sized mathematical mysteries every day.
scenes.visual: cozy workspace with a glowing laptop screen and a steaming ceramic mug of hot tea
